preconditions: Owned temporary current projects. Recorded-build unit fixtures are explicitly synthetic; a separate isolated integration uses actual generated module and ZIP distributions. Cache files are explicitly installed by the fixture, never by the read-only product API.

R: owned guarded files; actual short reads. EACCES and EMFILE use isolated native processes. Memory failures are labelled injections; the separate address-space case performs a real refused allocation inside an explicitly injected allocator, not the actual cache initializer minimum.
steps: Compare complete incoming, outgoing and combined relation views for every artifact against the independent fresh scan, including isolated sources.
Exercise missing/deleted/stale/malformed entries, binding substitutions and rehashed invalid adjacency; compare exact results and unchanged project file bytes.
Verify original-source failures still propagate and actual module/ZIP builds reuse a validated cache without normal adjacency reconstruction.

oracle.requirement_contract: Ein verwendeter persistenter Cacheeintrag MUSS den vollständigen Inhaltshash- und Abhängigkeitsnachweis aus Anhang O.3 erfüllen.
oracle.scope: Each usable adjacency entry binds recorded tool build/algorithm/version, runtime, schema, relation policy, complete current configuration bytes and all current artifact paths/content hashes. Its payload hash is checked, then every ID, endpoint, direction, coverage and order is independently checked against fresh resolved edges. Self-consistent rehashing cannot omit, duplicate, reorder or invent a relation. Real generated module and ZIP distributions share a valid cache after relocation. R adds bounded streaming structure preflight and bytearray accumulation without retained per-read fragments. Native access/descriptor refusal, labelled allocation failures and observed cache changes fall back completely; original-source changes and programming/interruption failures retain their own errors. The selected one-byte-read Python allocation window stays below 1 MiB for 160 KiB input; this is not RSS or a host capacity promise. 6.g.C moves unchanged cache binding/encoding/shape helpers into _relation_cache_values. Native reads, descriptor guards, strict decoding, fallback exceptions and the authoritative reader retain their existing behavior. W/R test identities and open scope limits are unchanged.

open_items: Partial current-project relation-reader integration only. CLI-wide cache selection, other cache kinds, adaptive CPU/memory accounting and persistent Work continuation, full runtime/platform acceptance and performance benchmarks remain open. Parsed cache objects can exceed the read-byte allowance in memory; the allowance is not an RSS cap. Real native error observations and labelled injections are distinguished.
